statusDetail: Public login audited; 3 checks requiring authenticated banking/account access are blocked by the credential boundary.

page.framework: legacy server-rendered JSP/HTML with JavaScript redirects
page.notes: The m. entry redirects to login.jsp and, in some browser runs, onward to fixed-width ibank.klikbca.com. Only the public authentication surface was safe to exercise.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark/reduced screenshot remains a hard-coded white, blue and yellow surface; style.css has no prefers-color-scheme rule.

checkOutcomes.method: Reduced-motion emulation plus authored HTML/CSS inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The login contains an auto-advancing eight-image banner, while CSS has no prefers-reduced-motion handling.

checkOutcomes.method: axe-core contrast audit plus CSS inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Axe measured contrast as low as 2.09:1 and no prefers-contrast/forced-colors adaptation exists.

checkOutcomes.method: CDP CSS/runtime probe and route observation
checkOutcomes.evidence: The entry performs JavaScript document redirects and the carousel swaps state; CDP found no view-transition CSS.
No scroll-linked animation, parallax, reveal or scrollytelling surface exists on the public login page.
checkOutcomes.reason: No scroll-linked animation, parallax, reveal or scrollytelling surface exists on the public login page.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered control probe plus authored HTML inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Carousel navigation is hand-wired to onclick anchors without href; no scroll-snap or native gesture semantics were found.
The public login is a short, single-screen form with no sticky chrome or meaningful scroll state.
checkOutcomes.reason: The public login is a short, single-screen form with no sticky chrome or meaningful scroll state.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip, popover, anchored menu or similar overlay is present on the public login.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, popover, anchored menu or similar overlay is present on the public login.

checkOutcomes.method: Runtime controls and authored banner markup inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Carousel arrows are href-less anchors and image banners are onclick-only, so navigation state and focus movement are not semantically communicated.

checkOutcomes.method: Visual inspection at normal and preference-emulated load
checkOutcomes.evidence: Load screenshots show no consent wall, interstitial or content-obscuring popup.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered DOM and authored HTML inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: DOM inspection found no custom modal/popover/disclosure overlay requiring a semantic primitive.
The viewport is dominated by legacy framed chrome and empty space while the login content is rendered extremely small.
At a 360px viewport the layout primitive reports a 980 CSS-pixel layout viewport and no effective viewport meta; the page is scaled down rather than reflowed.
CSS has zero media queries and no @container rules; fixed-width tables and absolute positions govern layout.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse target-size audit plus focused computed style
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse target-size passed and CDP measured a visible browser focus outline on the first link.
The first view clearly asks for User ID and Internet Banking PIN and exposes a LOGIN action.

checkOutcomes.method: Attempted public journey recon; stopped at credential boundary
checkOutcomes.evidence: End-to-end banking login and post-authentication tasks require valid customer credentials, which were not available and must not be fabricated.
checkOutcomes.reason: End-to-end banking login and post-authentication tasks require valid customer credentials, which were not available and must not be fabricated.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Client validation reports mistakes with blocking alert() calls and has no inline, persistent or programmatically associated recovery text.

checkOutcomes.method: DevTools trace summary corroborated with Lighthouse
checkOutcomes.evidence: The entry-url trace measured LCP 3.74s, outside the good 2.5s range, although Lighthouse on the redirected login measured 2.3s.
Layout observed CLS 0.0018 and Lighthouse measured CLS 0.025, both within the good range.
Trace observed no long tasks and 0ms TBT; Lighthouse measured 90ms TBT.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against live script attributes
checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR captured 53 requests/1.30MB, parser-blocking classic scripts without async/defer, uncompressed JS up to 329KB, and multiple high-priority styles/scripts.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse unused-code audit and HAR summary
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 46KiB unused JavaScript; HAR shows jsencrypt and security scripts loaded across both m. and ibank. redirect documents.
Axe found both credential inputs unlabelled, 16 image-alt failures and unnamed image links; the image probe found 23/23 rendered images missing alt.
Axe found seven contrast failures, including orange-on-white at 2.09:1.

checkOutcomes.method: axe-core structure audit and runtime controls
checkOutcomes.evidence: Axe found no main landmark or h1 and extensive content outside landmarks; carousel anchors are not real links.
The 360px screenshot shows the fixed desktop layout scaled to tiny text; CSS includes 9px and 10px text sizes.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse meta-viewport audit and mobile layout
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse fails meta-viewport because maximum-scale is below 5; the layout does not reflow at 360px.
Lighthouse reports no browser console errors; CDP recorded no uncaught exceptions.

checkOutcomes.method: CDP document probe and image audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The journey reaches a document with no parsed doctype and windows-1252, while the image audit reports 10 missing dimensions and one oversized image.

checkOutcomes.method: CDP Log capture and DOM/source inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: CDP logs malformed viewport-meta parsing and a password field outside a form; multiple actions use javascript: URLs.
The title is generic and both raw/rendered probes find no meta description.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw HTML, Lighthouse and robots fetch
checkOutcomes.evidence: The raw entry depends on JavaScript redirect, Full Site/Privacy actions use javascript: URLs, and robots.txt returns a branded 404 page.

checkOutcomes.method: Static metadata and direct robots/sitemap fetch
checkOutcomes.evidence: No canonical is present and both robots.txt and sitemap.xml return 404 content; no consistent indexing signals were found.
The public surface is a credential login, not an article, product, event or other rich entity that warrants schema.org or social-preview metadata.
checkOutcomes.reason: The public surface is a credential login, not an article, product, event or other rich entity that warrants schema.org or social-preview metadata.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct response-header capture plus cookie audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS, HSTS, nosniff and SAMEORIGIN are present on m. responses, but CSP, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent; one 400-day cookie is not Secure.
Tracker scan found no known analytics trackers; network origins are limited to m.klikbca.com and the same-organisation ibank.klikbca.com.

checkOutcomes.method: CDP load probe and authenticated-flow boundary
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission prompt occurs on load, but the authentication methods available after the credential boundary (including passkey support) cannot be inspected without an account.
checkOutcomes.reason: No permission prompt occurs on load, but the authentication methods available after the credential boundary (including passkey support) cannot be inspected without an account.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Clickjacking and HSTS defenses exist, but CSP/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent and all cookies report SameSite=None.
Discoverability measured only 2% raw/rendered content overlap and isJsShell=true; without JS the page only says JavaScript is required.

checkOutcomes.method: Repeated rendered navigation plus DOM/static inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The same entry journey inconsistently transitions from m. login to fixed-width ibank desktop UI, and overlays/navigation rely on brittle javascript: handlers and absolute positioning.
Authenticated internet banking is intrinsically online and transaction data must not be presented as operable offline; no installability intent is evident.
checkOutcomes.reason: Authenticated internet banking is intrinsically online and transaction data must not be presented as operable offline; no installability intent is evident.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Representative missing routes (/robots.txt and /sitemap.xml) return a bare legacy 404 with no navigation or recovery action.

checkOutcomes.method: axe lang audit plus static CSS/DOM probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The bilingual Indonesian/English page has no html lang or dir; CSS uses no logical properties.
The public login presents no dates, currencies, durations or locale-formatted values to assess.
checkOutcomes.reason: The public login presents no dates, currencies, durations or locale-formatted values to assess.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The public login presents no event scheduling or time-zone-sensitive data.
checkOutcomes.reason: The public login presents no event scheduling or time-zone-sensitive data.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Public login copy states its purpose, contains no consent wall, upsell, pricing or forced-continuity choice, and exposes no misleading default.
Validation uses blocking alert() messages, focuses fields manually, and provides no inline aria-live/aria-invalid feedback.
Both User ID and password/PIN inputs explicitly set autocomplete="off" instead of appropriate username/current-password tokens.

checkOutcomes.method: Attempted account-flow recon; stopped at credential boundary
checkOutcomes.evidence: Cancellation, transaction confirmation, reauthentication and account-management flows are behind valid customer authentication and could not be exercised safely.
checkOutcomes.reason: Cancellation, transaction confirmation, reauthentication and account-management flows are behind valid customer authentication and could not be exercised safely.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Image audit reports 23 legacy GIF/PNG/JPG images, no modern formats, 10 missing dimensions, five missing srcset and one oversized asset.
The login fetches all eight banner images and 12 scripts during the entry journey, including duplicate libraries across redirects.
The lightweight login transfers 1.30MB; 1.19MB is attributed to the ibank subdomain and includes eight promotional banners plus large scripts.
A high-sensitivity authenticated banking login has no declared agent-facing surface; exposing transaction tools is not assumed appropriate.
checkOutcomes.reason: A high-sensitivity authenticated banking login has no declared agent-facing surface; exposing transaction tools is not assumed appropriate.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The public login has no summarisation, generation or other inference task where built-in on-device AI would improve the experience.
checkOutcomes.reason: The public login has no summarisation, generation or other inference task where built-in on-device AI would improve the experience.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline/post heap comparison after repeated real interaction
checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten carousel-next interactions heap self-size decreased from 8,602,299 to 8,535,825 bytes; node count changed only 132,280 to 132,410.
Baseline heap is 8.6MB with 132,280 nodes; CDP reports 10.6MB JS heap and 498 DOM nodes, proportionate for this page.

checkOutcomes.method: Before/after heap constructor and total comparison
checkOutcomes.evidence: Neither heap summary reports Detached* constructors, and repeated carousel interaction produced only 130 additional snapshot nodes with lower total self-size.

principleOutcomes.reason: A high-sensitivity authenticated banking login has no declared agent-facing surface; exposing transaction tools is not assumed appropriate. The public login has no summarisation, generation or other inference task where built-in on-device AI would improve the experience.

paths.description: Entry redirect and public login archetype; represents the only unauthenticated core surface.
Credential form markup and client validation/error recovery, without submitting credentials.
Repeated public carousel interaction for memory retention.
Post-login transaction, account, reauthentication and completion paths; not covered because valid customer credentials were unavailable.

findings.summary: Dark mode is not supported
findings.evidence: Dark/reduced screenshot remains a hard-coded white, blue and yellow surface; style.css has no prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme and a prefers-color-scheme/light-dark() token palette.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference is ignored
findings.evidence: The login contains an auto-advancing eight-image banner, while CSS has no prefers-reduced-motion handling.
findings.suggestedFix: Pause auto-advance and disable non-essential transitions under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails WCAG AA
findings.evidence: Axe measured contrast as low as 2.09:1 and no prefers-contrast/forced-colors adaptation exists.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace low-contrast orange/white and white/blue pairs and verify forced-colors.

findings.summary: State changes do not use view transitions
findings.evidence: The entry performs JavaScript document redirects and the carousel swaps state; CDP found no view-transition CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance route and carousel state swaps with View Transitions while preserving reduced motion.

findings.summary: Carousel controls fight platform semantics
findings.evidence: Carousel navigation is hand-wired to onclick anchors without href; no scroll-snap or native gesture semantics were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Use buttons or scroll-snap carousel controls with keyboard, touch and accessible state.

findings.summary: Navigation state is not communicated
findings.evidence: Carousel arrows are href-less anchors and image banners are onclick-only, so navigation state and focus movement are not semantically communicated.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic controls and announce/highlight the active carousel item and destination.

findings.summary: Legacy chrome overwhelms the login
findings.evidence: The viewport is dominated by legacy framed chrome and empty space while the login content is rendered extremely small.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace framed tables and decorative chrome with a focused, content-first login card.

findings.summary: Mobile layout is a scaled desktop canvas
findings.evidence: At a 360px viewport the layout primitive reports a 980 CSS-pixel layout viewport and no effective viewport meta; the page is scaled down rather than reflowed.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a valid viewport meta and fluid intrinsic layout that reflows at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Components cannot adapt to available space
findings.evidence: CSS has zero media queries and no @container rules; fixed-width tables and absolute positions govern layout.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed table widths/absolute positions and adopt intrinsic/container-responsive components.

findings.summary: Validation offers weak recovery
findings.evidence: Client validation reports mistakes with blocking alert() calls and has no inline, persistent or programmatically associated recovery text.
findings.suggestedFix: Render inline actionable status with retry guidance and preserved context.

findings.summary: Entry LCP is slow across redirects
findings.evidence: The entry-url trace measured LCP 3.74s, outside the good 2.5s range, although Lighthouse on the redirected login measured 2.3s.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redirect work, prioritise the actual LCP and serve the correct login document directly.

findings.summary: Resource delivery is inefficient
findings.evidence: HAR captured 53 requests/1.30MB, parser-blocking classic scripts without async/defer, uncompressed JS up to 329KB, and multiple high-priority styles/scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Compress scripts, defer noncritical classic JS, avoid duplicate redirect loads and trim blocking chains.

findings.summary: Unused and duplicate JavaScript ships on login
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 46KiB unused JavaScript; HAR shows jsencrypt and security scripts loaded across both m. and ibank. redirect documents.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused code and load crypto/security dependencies once, only when needed.

findings.summary: Credential fields and images lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Axe found both credential inputs unlabelled, 16 image-alt failures and unnamed image links; the image probe found 23/23 rendered images missing alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate labels with both fields and add meaningful alt or empty alt for decoration.

findings.summary: Essential text has insufficient contrast
findings.evidence: Axe found seven contrast failures, including orange-on-white at 2.09:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt tested contrast-safe design tokens meeting at least WCAG AA.

findings.summary: Document landmarks and heading structure are missing
findings.evidence: Axe found no main landmark or h1 and extensive content outside landmarks; carousel anchors are not real links.
findings.suggestedFix: Use header/main/footer landmarks, a descriptive h1 and semantic carousel buttons.

findings.summary: Text is too small to read comfortably
findings.evidence: The 360px screenshot shows the fixed desktop layout scaled to tiny text; CSS includes 9px and 10px text sizes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use responsive rem-based typography and remove the scaled fixed-width canvas.

findings.summary: Viewport prevents zoom and reflow
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails meta-viewport because maximum-scale is below 5; the layout does not reflow at 360px.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale restrictions and support 320px reflow and user zoom.

findings.summary: Document and image foundations are unsound
findings.evidence: The journey reaches a document with no parsed doctype and windows-1252, while the image audit reports 10 missing dimensions and one oversized image.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve standards-mode UTF-8 HTML and reserve correct image dimensions.

findings.summary: Browser platform hygiene warnings remain
findings.evidence: CDP logs malformed viewport-meta parsing and a password field outside a form; multiple actions use javascript: URLs.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix viewport syntax, place password fields in the form and replace javascript: links.

findings.summary: Search metadata is incomplete
findings.evidence: The title is generic and both raw/rendered probes find no meta description.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a specific login title and concise meta description.

findings.summary: Entry and links depend on JavaScript
findings.evidence: The raw entry depends on JavaScript redirect, Full Site/Privacy actions use javascript: URLs, and robots.txt returns a branded 404 page.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the login directly and use real href/action URLs with a valid robots.txt.

findings.summary: Canonical and indexing signals are absent
findings.evidence: No canonical is present and both robots.txt and sitemap.xml return 404 content; no consistent indexing signals were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a canonical and intentional robots/sitemap policy for the public login.

findings.summary: Security policy and cookie gaps remain
findings.evidence: HTTPS, HSTS, nosniff and SAMEORIGIN are present on m. responses, but CSP, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent; one 400-day cookie is not Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strict CSP and policy headers; make every cookie Secure with an appropriate SameSite value.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are incomplete
findings.evidence: Clickjacking and HSTS defenses exist, but CSP/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent and all cookies report SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP frame-ancestors/Trusted Types as appropriate plus Referrer- and Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Core entry is unavailable without JavaScript
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 2% raw/rendered content overlap and isJsShell=true; without JS the page only says JavaScript is required.
findings.suggestedFix: Return useful login content and a real navigation target in server HTML, then enhance with JS.

findings.summary: Runtime routing is brittle and form-factor dependent
findings.evidence: The same entry journey inconsistently transitions from m. login to fixed-width ibank desktop UI, and overlays/navigation rely on brittle javascript: handlers and absolute positioning.
findings.suggestedFix: Eliminate chained UA/JS redirects and serve one resilient responsive login.

findings.summary: HTTP failure pages offer no recovery
findings.evidence: Representative missing routes (/robots.txt and /sitemap.xml) return a bare legacy 404 with no navigation or recovery action.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide branded 404/timeout/offline states with retry and home/login actions.

findings.summary: Bilingual content has no language metadata
findings.evidence: The bilingual Indonesian/English page has no html lang or dir; CSS uses no logical properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set document and phrase-level lang, dir support, and logical CSS properties.

findings.summary: Form errors rely on blocking alerts
findings.evidence: Validation uses blocking alert() messages, focuses fields manually, and provides no inline aria-live/aria-invalid feedback.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after interaction with inline, visible and aria-live feedback.

findings.summary: Credential autofill is disabled
findings.evidence: Both User ID and password/PIN inputs explicitly set autocomplete="off" instead of appropriate username/current-password tokens.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=username and current-password (or an appropriate PIN strategy) without blocking paste.

findings.summary: Login images are not resource-efficient
findings.evidence: Image audit reports 23 legacy GIF/PNG/JPG images, no modern formats, 10 missing dimensions, five missing srcset and one oversized asset.
findings.suggestedFix: Convert eligible assets to AVIF/WebP/SVG, provide dimensions/srcset and load only the active banner.

findings.summary: The page performs avoidable network work
findings.evidence: The login fetches all eight banner images and 12 scripts during the entry journey, including duplicate libraries across redirects.
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid loading both mobile and desktop documents and fetch promotional slides on demand.

findings.summary: Page weight is disproportionate to the login task
findings.evidence: The lightweight login transfers 1.30MB; 1.19MB is attributed to the ibank subdomain and includes eight promotional banners plus large scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a login weight budget and defer promotional media and nonessential scripts.

taskList.title: Rebuild the login as one responsive, zoomable, progressively enhanced document
Make credential entry and page structure accessible
Replace alerts and enable safe autofill
Remove redirect duplication and reduce entry payload
Respect color, motion and contrast preferences
Modernise document, controls and carousel semantics
Add intentional metadata and crawler endpoints
